lines: Kuchh to duniya ki inaayaat ne dil tod diya
couplets.en: The world broke my heart, in part, with its kindness.

lines: Aur kuchh talkhi-e-haalaat ne dil tod diya
couplets.en: The bitterness of my days did its share.

lines: Hum to samjhe the ke barsaat mein barsegi sharaab
couplets.en: I thought the rain would come down as wine.

lines: Hum to samjhe the ke barsaat mein barsegi sharaab
couplets.en: I thought the rain would come down as wine.

lines: Aayi barsaat to barsaat ne dil tod diya
couplets.en: When the rain came, it broke my heart.

lines: Dil to rota rahe aur aankh se aansoo na bahe
couplets.en: Let the heart go on weeping without a tear falling.

lines: Ishq ki aisi riwaayaat ne dil tod diya
couplets.en: Such were the laws of love that broke my heart.

lines: Woh mere hain, mujhe mil jaayenge, aa jaayenge
couplets.en: My beloved is mine and will come to me, surely will come.

lines: Aise bekaar khayaalaat ne dil tod diya
couplets.en: Such idle hopes broke my heart.

lines: Aap ko pyaar hai mujh se ke nahin hai mujh se?
couplets.en: Do you love me, or do you feel nothing for me?

lines: Jaane kyun aise sawaalaat ne dil tod diya
couplets.en: Who knows why such questions broke my heart.

lines: Kuchh to duniya ki inaayaat ne dil tod diya
couplets.en: The world broke my heart, in part, with its kindness.
